meta.priceBasis: price = regular (pre-markdown) price as listed by the retailer on its own site for that market, before sales tax/VAT/IVA unless the market's shelf price is tax-inclusive by law (GB, IE, MX). salePrice records a markdown seen on 2026-10-05, else null.
meta.confirmedMeaning: true = read on the product page itself (price tied to a named SKU on the brand's own domain); false = category listing, search-engine snippet or secondary retailer.
meta.scope: Only brands NOT already present in the game's existing clothing-brands.json for that category. Categories: footwear, bags, accessories, watches, jewelry.
